## Change

Explain the problem and resulting behavior. Include migration instructions or
upstream release notes when relevant.

## Validation

List checks that ran and their results. State any checks that could not run.

- [ ] Documentation matches the change.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate.py` passes.
- [ ] Deployment changes were checked with the container smoke test, or the limitation is explained.
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, deployment data, or unredacted logs are included.
